brief: Write a conversational blog post about giving an AI coding agent useful freedom without handing it the keys to everything. Develop a clear take with a concrete hypothetical example of a tool permission going too far and how revision-bound approval helps. Explain the choices in prose, not a permission questionnaire or a checklist. Do not invent personal experience or test results.
writerPersona: Agent-safety editorial lens: explain permission boundaries and failure modes without claiming personal testing.
